gaps.sentence: The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.

gaps.sentence: There is no ___ (PROVE) that he was anywhere near the bank.
gaps.explanation: 'No proof that …' — the noun for evidence.

gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.
